scripts.architecture:check: pnpm run architecture:deps && pnpm run architecture:boundaries
scripts.dry-run: turbo run format:check lint typecheck test build --dry=json
scripts.format: prettier --write AGENTS.md package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml turbo.json eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs .dependency-cruiser.cjs docs/agent apps packages tooling tests
scripts.format:check: prettier --check AGENTS.md package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml turbo.json eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs .dependency-cruiser.cjs docs/agent apps packages tooling tests
scripts.lint: pnpm run workspace:check && pnpm run config:check && pnpm run lint:eslint && pnpm run architecture:check && pnpm run codegen:check && pnpm run contract:check && pnpm run agent:check
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run config:check && turbo run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run config:fixtures && pnpm run typecheck:fixtures && pnpm run lint:fixtures && pnpm run architecture:fixtures && pnpm run contract:fixtures && pnpm run admin:bundle:fixtures && pnpm run agent:fixtures && turbo run test
scripts.validate: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
